paragraphs: The GLS400 was part of the first-generation GLS range (X166, 2015–2019), powered by the M276 — a 3.0-litre V6 petrol engine that served as a key petrol option in the large SUV lineup of that era. The GLS400 sat alongside diesel and V8 variants in the range, offering a smooth V6 petrol alternative to the more common diesel options. The M276 is a well-known Mercedes V6 platform, used across multiple models of that generation. The GLS400 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every GLS400 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the GLS400 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because the GLS400 uses the M276 engine, ensuring the correct specification matters when sourcing parts or considering a replacement. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:
